prerequisite_2_qa_005_classification.question: Muon lam OT thi can ai phe duyet truoc?
prerequisite_2_qa_005_classification.expected_answer: Can co su dong y cua NLD va phe duyet truoc cua quan ly truc tiep.
prerequisite_2_qa_005_classification.gold_chunk_text: 4.1. Lam them gio chi thuc hien khi co su dong y cua NLD va phe duyet truoc cua quan ly truc tiep (can cu Dieu 107).
prerequisite_2_qa_005_classification.evidence_analysis: context_found=True - gold chunk ::0004 THUC SU nam trong retrieved pool (vi tri 3, score thap hon). Chunk ::0007 (rank 1, duoc cited [Nguon 1]) CUNG co mot dang bang chung ve 'NLD dong y' o buoc 3: 'NLD xac nhan dong y (chu ky hoac phe duyet tren he thong HRIS)'. Response THUC TE: 'Theo Chinh sach OT... muon lam OT can co phe duyet truoc cua quan ly truc tiep [Nguon 1]. Trong quy trinh chinh thuc, quan ly truc tiep gui Phieu dang ky OT, sau do Truong bo phan phe duyet; neu vuot 20 gio/thang/nguoi thi phai co them phe duyet cua Phong Nhan su [Nguon 1].' -> generation CHI dung buoc 1-2 cua chunk ::0007, BO SOT ca buoc 3 cua chunk ::0007 LAN toan bo chunk ::0004 (nguyen tac 'su dong y cua NLD').
prerequisite_2_qa_005_classification.conclusion: Retrieval THANH CONG (ca 2 nguon co bang chung deu nam trong context). Generation KHONG tong hop day du - bo sot ve 'su dong y cua NLD' du bang chung co san o CA HAI chunk duoc retrieve. Day la loi sinh cau tra loi khong day du (content-completeness), KHONG phai retrieval-miss, KHONG phai router bug, KHONG phai judge error (cau tra loi thuc su thieu 1 fact so voi expected, judge cham dung).
prerequisite_2_qa_005_classification.relation_to_other_cases: Cung co che voi qa_047 (bo sot dieu khoan ngoai le BHXH nguoi nuoc ngoai du chunk chua dieu khoan do duoc retrieve) - ca hai deu la 'generation chi tong hop tu chunk/doan xep hang cao nhat, bo qua fact bo sung o chunk/doan khac trong cung context', KHAC co che voi P1 (confidence_score bi kep 0.1 gay escalate) - qa_005 KHONG escalate, van tra loi nhung thieu 1 fact.
prerequisite_2_qa_005_classification.note_for_f2_ordering: qa_005 va qa_047 KHONG khop vao dung 4 P-step (P1 confidence=0.1 / P2 ambiguous router / P3 retrieval miss / P4 judge error) ma Ted da lock. Can Ted quyet dinh: (a) mo rong P1 thanh 'generation/confidence cluster' bao gom ca 2 co che, hay (b) giu qa_005/047 la FAIL_PRODUCT_BUG da duoc giai thich (co primary_root_cause ro rang = G6) nhung CHUA sua trong vong F.2 nay, bao cao trung thuc o F.4 thay vi ep vao mot trong 4 P-step khong khop.
